# Tool reference

A tool is the only way an agent touches the world. Everything an agent
can do is in this list; nothing outside it is reachable.

**73 tools** across 12 categories. 24 of them change state.

## How to read this

- **Mutates** means the call changes something. Those go through the
  approval policy before they run and leave an audit row after.
- **Risk** drives the autonomy floor. `critical` can never run
  unattended at any autonomy level.
- **Auto from** is the lowest autonomy level at which the tool runs
  without a human. Blank means it is derived from risk.

| Risk | Runs unattended from |
|---|---|
| `internal` | `observe` (platform records only, never the client's site) |
| `none` / `low` | `assisted` |
| `medium` | `managed` |
| `high` | `autopilot` |
| `critical` | never |

## analytics

### `analytics.ctr_gaps`

Find pages that rank well but are not clicked. Almost always a title
and meta description problem, which makes them the fastest fix in SEO:
no new content, no developer, measurable within two weeks.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | integer | no | Days of data |
| `min_impressions` | integer | no | Ignore pages below this |

### `analytics.index_status`

Ask Google directly whether a URL is indexed, what canonical it chose,
and why it is excluded if it is. Use this when a page is not appearing and
you need the actual reason rather than a guess.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | The URL to inspect |

### `analytics.kpi_trend`

Read a stored KPI's history, with the change over the period. Use this
to tell whether what we did is working, and to catch a decline early.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metric` | string | yes | Metric name |
| `days` | integer | no | How far back |

### `analytics.page_speed`

Run PageSpeed Insights on a URL: lab metrics, real-user Core Web Vitals
where available, and the specific opportunities with their time savings.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | URL to test |
| `strategy` | `mobile` \| `desktop` | no | Device |

### `analytics.record_kpi`

Store a KPI measurement so trends and regressions can be detected
later. Use this after measuring anything the client should see move over
time.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metric` | string | yes | Metric name, e.g. organic_clicks, ai_share_of_voice, health_score |
| `value` | number | yes | The measured value |
| `measured_on` | string | no | ISO date; defaults to today |
| `dimension` | string | no | Optional breakdown, e.g. a country or page type |
| `source` | string | no | Where it came from |

### `analytics.search_performance`

Query Google Search Console. This is the only first-party record of
what the site actually ranks for, so prefer it over any estimate.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dimensions` | array | no | Dimensions to group by |
| `days` | integer | no | How many days back |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum rows |
| `filter_page` | string | no | Only rows for this page URL |
| `filter_query_contains` | string | no | Only queries containing this string |

### `analytics.striking_distance`

Find queries ranking between positions 4 and 20 with real impressions.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | integer | no | Days of data |
| `min_impressions` | integer | no | Ignore queries below this |

### `analytics.traffic_and_conversions`

Organic sessions, conversions and revenue by landing page from GA4.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | integer | no | Days of data |

## brand

### `brand.add_facts`

Add verified claims to the fact ledger. Every fact needs a source: a
client document, a page on their site, or a named external reference.
A fact with no source is a guess and does not belong here.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `facts` | array | yes | Facts to add |

### `brand.check_voice`

Score a draft against the brand profile and report exactly what to
change. Run this before anything reaches a human reviewer: a client should
never be the one to notice that a draft uses a banned phrase.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | The draft to check |

### `brand.facts`

Read the fact ledger: the verified claims this brand is willing to make
in public, with their sources.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no | Filter to facts matching this topic |
| `category` | `pricing` \| `capability` \| `credential` \| `metric` \| `policy` \| `people` \| `general` | no | Filter by category |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many |

### `brand.profile`

Read the active brand profile: positioning, audiences, tone, the words
to use and avoid, required disclaimers and CTA patterns.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

Takes no parameters.

### `brand.save_profile`

Write a new version of the brand profile. Never edits the old one: a
published page can always be traced to the voice rules in force when it
was written.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted` · **Approval type:** `brand_profile`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `one_liner` | string | yes | What the company does, in one sentence, in their words |
| `tone_attributes` | array | yes | Three to six adjectives for the voice |
| `audiences` | array | yes | Who they sell to |
| `value_props` | array | no | What they claim as their value |
| `differentiators` | array | no | What makes them different from named competitors |
| `proof_points` | array | no | Evidence they can cite: numbers, awards, named clients |
| `vocabulary_prefer` | array | no | Words and phrases they use |
| `vocabulary_avoid` | array | no | Words and phrases they never use |
| `banned_phrases` | array | no | Phrases that must never appear |
| `reading_level` | string | no | Target reading level, e.g. 'plain English, grade 8' |
| `person` | `first` \| `second` \| `third` | no | Narrative person |
| `sentence_rhythm` | string | no | How their sentences move, e.g. 'short, declarative, few subclauses' |
| `claims_policy` | string | no | What they will and will not claim in public |
| `required_disclaimers` | array | no | Disclaimers that must appear |
| `cta_patterns` | array | no | How they ask for the next step |
| `example_passages` | array | no | Two or three passages of their own best writing |
| `derived_from` | array | no | Brand asset ids this was distilled from |

### `brand.search_assets`

Search the client's uploaded documents and crawled pages for passages
relevant to a topic. Use this to ground a draft in what the company has
actually said rather than in what sounds plausible.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | What you are looking for |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many passages |
| `kinds` | array | no | Restrict to these asset kinds |

## content

### `content.create`

Create a content item. Starts at 'idea' and moves through the pipeline
as each specialist finishes with it. The client only ever sees it at
'review'.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `propose`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | Working title |
| `content_type` | `article` \| `pillar` \| `comparison` \| `listicle` \| `how_to` \| `glossary` \| `landing_page` \| `product_page` \| `category_page` \| `case_study` \| `faq` \| `location_page` \| `meta_rewrite` \| `on_page_update` \| `programmatic` | no | What kind of page |
| `primary_keyword` | string | no | The single query this page is for |
| `secondary_keywords` | array | no | Supporting queries |
| `search_intent` | `informational` \| `commercial` \| `transactional` \| `navigational` \| `local` | no | Intent |
| `target_url` | string | no | Existing URL if this updates a live page |
| `funnel_stage` | `awareness` \| `consideration` \| `decision` | no | Stage |
| `priority_score` | number | no | 0 to 100: how much this matters |

### `content.generate_schema`

Generate valid JSON-LD for a page and attach it to the content item.
Picks the type from the page's purpose and drops empty properties, because
markup with blank fields validates as broken.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_id` | string | yes | The content item |
| `schema_type` | string | no | Force a specific schema.org type |
| `properties` | object | no | Extra properties to include |

### `content.get`

Read a content item: brief, outline, body, scores and gate results.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_id` | string | yes | The content item |
| `include_body` | boolean | no | Include the full body text |

### `content.queue`

List content at a given stage. Use this to find what needs work rather
than creating something new when there is a half-finished draft sitting
in the pipeline.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `statuses` | array | no | Stages to include |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum items |

### `content.save_brief`

Attach a brief to a content item and move it to 'briefed'.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `propose`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_id` | string | yes | The content item |
| `brief` | object | yes | The brief |
| `outline` | array | no | Section headings in order |

### `content.save_draft`

Save draft body copy. Runs the quality gates automatically and reports
what still needs fixing, so the next pass is targeted rather than a
general rewrite.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `propose`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_id` | string | yes | The content item |
| `body_markdown` | string | yes | The full draft in markdown |
| `meta_title` | string | no | Title tag, 50 to 60 characters |
| `meta_description` | string | no | Meta description, 140 to 160 characters |
| `title` | string | no | Updated H1 or working title |
| `external_sources` | array | no | Sources cited, as objects with url and claim |
| `internal_links` | array | no | Internal links used |
| `advance` | boolean | no | Move the item forward in the pipeline |

### `content.submit_for_review`

Move a finished draft into the client's approval queue. Refuses if any
automated gate is still failing: the client's time is for judging
substance, not for catching things we should have caught.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `medium` · **Runs unattended from:** `propose` · **Approval type:** `content_publish`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_id` | string | yes | The content item |
| `note` | string | no | What the reviewer should pay attention to |

## crawl

### `crawl.fetch`

Fetch a single URL and return its content. Use this to read a
competitor page, check whether a fix went live, or look at any page on the
open web. Private and internal addresses are refused.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | The URL to fetch |
| `extract` | `text` \| `html` \| `signals` | no | What to return |

### `crawl.internal_link_suggestions`

Find pages that should link to a given URL, with the exact anchor text
to use and the sentence it fits into. Internal linking is the highest
leverage change available without a developer, and this makes it concrete
rather than a vague recommendation.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target_url` | string | yes | The URL that needs more internal links |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many suggestions |

### `crawl.page`

Fetch and analyse one URL in detail: on-page elements, schema, AEO
citability, readability and machine-writing tells. Use this for a single
page rather than crawling the whole site.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | The full URL to analyse |

### `crawl.robots`

Read robots.txt and report which AI and search crawlers are allowed or
blocked. Blocking retrieval crawlers is the single most common reason a
site is invisible in AI answers.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

Takes no parameters.

### `crawl.site`

Crawl the client's site and run every deterministic check: technical,
content, schema, AEO and internal linking. This is the backbone of the
audit. Results are stored, so findings are reconciled against the last
crawl rather than duplicated.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_pages` | integer | no | How many pages to crawl |
| `max_depth` | integer | no | How many clicks deep from the homepage |
| `include_subdomains` | boolean | no | Include subdomains |

## keywords

### `keywords.cluster`

Group keywords into topic clusters by shared terms and intent.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keywords` | array | yes | Keywords to cluster |
| `min_cluster_size` | integer | no | Smallest group to keep |

### `keywords.competitors`

Identify and store the domains that actually compete for this site's
queries, based on who ranks alongside it. This is more useful than the
client's own list of competitors, which is usually about who they meet in
sales meetings rather than who outranks them.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0400

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seed_keywords` | array | yes | Keywords to sample |
| `country` | string | no | Country code |

### `keywords.research`

Find keyword ideas around a seed term, with volume, difficulty and
intent. Falls back to Search Console queries when no paid data provider
is connected, which is often better anyway because those are terms the
site already appears for.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0500

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seed` | string | yes | The seed keyword or topic |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many ideas |
| `country` | string | no | Two-letter country code |

### `keywords.save`

Store keywords against the site so they can be tracked and assigned to
clusters and pages. Only save keywords you intend to act on; a list of
ten thousand terms nobody targets is noise.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keywords` | array | yes | Keywords to store |
| `track` | boolean | no | Mark these for ongoing rank tracking |
| `country` | string | no | Country code |

### `keywords.serp`

Fetch the live search results for a keyword: who ranks, what format
they use, which SERP features appear, and the People Also Ask questions.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0020

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | string | yes | The search query |
| `country` | string | no | Two-letter country code |
| `depth` | integer | no | How many results |

## local

### `local.audit_citations`

Check name, address and phone consistency across the directories that
matter. Inconsistent NAP undermines the confidence that drives map pack
ranking, and it is cheap to fix.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | string | yes | The location to check |

### `local.audit_profile`

Audit a Business Profile against what actually drives map pack ranking:
category selection, service coverage, hours, photos, review velocity and
the consistency of name, address and phone with the website.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | string | no | A specific location; defaults to all |

### `local.draft_gbp_post`

Draft a Business Profile post. Weekly posting keeps a profile active,
which is a visible signal to both searchers and the ranking system.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `medium` · **Runs unattended from:** `managed` · **Approval type:** `gbp_post`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | string | yes | The location |
| `summary_text` | string | yes | The post body, under 1500 characters |
| `topic_type` | `STANDARD` \| `EVENT` \| `OFFER` | no | Post type |
| `cta_type` | `BOOK` \| `ORDER` \| `SHOP` \| `LEARN_MORE` \| `SIGN_UP` \| `CALL` | no | Button |
| `cta_url` | string | no | Where the button goes |

### `local.draft_review_reply`

Draft a reply to a review. Positive replies may post automatically at
higher autonomy levels; anything negative or alleging harm always goes to
a person first, because a wrong reply to a complaint is a public mistake
and sometimes a legal one.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `medium` · **Runs unattended from:** `managed` · **Approval type:** `review_reply`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | string | yes | The review |
| `reply_text` | string | yes | The drafted reply, under 350 characters |

### `local.geo_grid`

Measure map pack rank across a grid of points around a location.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0500

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | string | yes | The search term, e.g. 'emergency dentist' |
| `location_id` | string | yes | Which location to centre on |
| `grid_size` | integer | no | Points per side; 5 gives 25 samples |
| `radius_km` | number | no | How far out to sample |

### `local.sync_locations`

Pull the client's Business Profile locations and store their current
state: categories, hours, services, attributes, photos and ratings.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

Takes no parameters.

### `local.sync_reviews`

Pull reviews for a location and classify them: sentiment, topics, and
whether they need a human rather than an automated reply.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | string | yes | The location |

## offpage

### `offpage.backlink_profile`

Fetch and store the site's backlink profile: referring domains,
anchor distribution, recently lost links and anything that looks toxic.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0500

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | How many links to pull |

### `offpage.draft_outreach`

Draft a personalised outreach email and queue it.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `medium` · **Runs unattended from:** `autopilot` · **Approval type:** `outreach_send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prospect_id` | string | yes | The qualified prospect |
| `subject` | string | yes | Subject line, under 80 characters |
| `body` | string | yes | The full email, under 200 words |
| `specific_reference` | string | yes | What you read on their site that prompted this, in your own words. This is what separates outreach from spam, and it is checked. |
| `contact_email` | string | no | Recipient address |
| `contact_name` | string | no | Recipient name |
| `campaign` | string | no | Campaign label |

### `offpage.find_unlinked_mentions`

Find pages that mention the brand without linking to it.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0200

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brand_terms` | array | yes | Brand names and product names to search for |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many results to check |

### `offpage.qualify_prospect`

Assess a domain as a link target before spending any effort on it.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none` · **Typical cost:** about $0.0100

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `domain` | string | yes | The domain to assess |
| `tactic` | `digital_pr` \| `broken_link` \| `unlinked_mention` \| `resource_page` \| `guest_contribution` \| `expert_quote` \| `data_study` \| `podcast` \| `partnership` \| `supplier_listing` \| `local_sponsorship` | yes | How you would approach them |
| `target_page_url` | string | no | The specific page you would want a link from |
| `rationale` | string | no | Why this site would plausibly link to us |

### `offpage.refuse_tactic`

Record that a link tactic was proposed and refused. Use this when
anyone, including the client, asks for bought links, link exchanges or a
private blog network, so the refusal and its reasoning are on record.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tactic` | string | yes | What was proposed |
| `requested_by` | string | no | Who asked |

### `offpage.send_outreach`

Send an approved outreach email through the client's own mail server.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `high` · **Runs unattended from:** `autopilot` · **Approval type:** `outreach_send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thread_id` | string | yes | The approved outreach thread |

## publish

### `publish.content`

Publish an approved content item to the client's CMS.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `high` · **Runs unattended from:** `managed` · **Approval type:** `content_publish`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content_id` | string | yes | The content item to publish |
| `status` | `draft` \| `published` \| `scheduled` | no | Publish state |

### `publish.submit_urls`

Push changed URLs to search engines so they are recrawled in minutes
rather than days. Uses IndexNow for Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver, and
the Bing API where connected.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | array | yes | URLs to submit |

### `publish.update_meta`

Rewrite a live page's title tag and meta description.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted` · **Approval type:** `technical_fix`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | The live page URL |
| `meta_title` | string | no | New title tag, 50 to 60 characters |
| `meta_description` | string | no | New meta description, 140 to 160 characters |
| `finding_id` | string | no | The finding this resolves, if any |

### `publish.verify_live`

Check that a published page is actually live, indexable and carrying
the changes we made. Always run this after publishing: a CMS reporting
success is not proof the page renders.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | The URL to verify |
| `expect_title` | string | no | Title that should appear |
| `expect_text` | string | no | A phrase that should be in the body |

### `publish.write_robots`

Replace robots.txt. Always requires a human, at every autonomy level:
one wrong line here can remove an entire site from search.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `critical` · **Approval type:** `robots_change` · **Tags:** `robots_txt_write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes | The complete new robots.txt |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why this change is needed |

## reporting

### `report.build`

Write or refresh a client-facing report. The 'live_audit' kind is the
always-current report the dashboard shows, and rewriting it is how the
client's view stays fresh rather than monthly.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `propose`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `live_audit` \| `monthly` \| `quarterly` \| `competitor` \| `content` \| `local` \| `aeo` \| `backlinks` \| `incident` \| `onboarding` | yes | Report kind |
| `title` | string | yes | Report title |
| `narrative_md` | string | yes | The written analysis in markdown: what changed, why it matters, and what happens next |
| `data` | object | no | Structured figures the dashboard renders |
| `period_days` | integer | no | Period this covers |
| `share` | boolean | no | Create a shareable link |

### `report.findings`

List the site's open findings, ranked by priority. This is the work
queue for every fixing agent: read it before deciding what to do.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `categories` | array | no | Filter by category |
| `severities` | array | no | Filter by severity |
| `auto_fixable` | boolean | no | Only findings the platform can fix itself |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many |

### `report.history`

Read what the platform has already done for this site: recent mission
runs, what each changed, and what it cost.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | How many runs |

### `report.mark_finding`

Update a finding's status. Use 'fixed' after applying a change,
'verified' once you have confirmed it live, 'wont_fix' with a reason if
the client has decided against it.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `propose`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `finding_id` | string | yes | The finding |
| `status` | `in_progress` \| `awaiting_approval` \| `fixed` \| `verified` \| `accepted_risk` \| `wont_fix` | yes | New status |
| `note` | string | no | Why, in one sentence |

### `report.notify`

Tell the client something. Use sparingly: a system that pings
constantly gets muted, and then the one message that mattered is missed.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `internal` · **Runs unattended from:** `observe`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | One line, specific |
| `body` | string | yes | What happened and what it means, in plain language |
| `severity` | `info` \| `warning` \| `action_required` \| `critical` | no | How urgent |
| `link` | string | no | Where to go to act on it |

### `report.site_state`

A single read of everything currently true about the site: scores,
open findings by severity, content pipeline, pending approvals, KPI
movement and connected integrations.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

Takes no parameters.

## research

### `research.company_profile`

Read a company's own pages and report what it actually sells, who to,
and what it can prove. Use this before any content decision: a brief
written without it is a guess about someone else's business.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | no | Site to profile. Defaults to the site in context. |
| `max_pages` | integer | no | How many pages to read |

### `research.rival_content`

Read the pages you are competing with and measure how they are built:
length, heading depth, format, schema, author attribution, freshness, and
the same voice fingerprint used on the client.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | array | yes | Competitor page URLs to read |

### `research.story_seeds`

Find the things this business can write about that nobody else can:
its own numbers, its own customers, its own process, its own refusals.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | no | Site to mine. Defaults to the site in context. |

### `research.voice_fingerprint`

Measure how a page or a site actually writes: sentence length and its
variance, reading grade, how often it says "we" against "you", hedging,
marketing filler, how many specifics it carries, passive voice.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | no | Page to measure. Defaults to the site's home page. |
| `text` | string | no | Measure this text directly instead of fetching a URL. |

### `research.voice_gap`

Compare how the client writes against how the pages they compete with
write, and say whether the tone should change.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `site_url` | string | no | Client page to measure. Defaults to the site in context. |
| `rival_urls` | array | yes | Competitor pages to compare against |

## social

### `social.calendar`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | `youtube` \| `instagram` \| `reddit` \| `x` \| `tiktok` \| `facebook` \| `linkedin` \| `pinterest` \| `threads` \| `snapchat` | yes | Which platform to plan |
| `posts_per_week` | integer | yes | Target cadence |
| `formats` | array | no | Formats to rotate |
| `weeks` | integer | no | How many weeks to plan |

### `social.capabilities`

What each social platform will and will not let this desk read, and why.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | `youtube` \| `instagram` \| `reddit` \| `x` \| `tiktok` \| `facebook` \| `linkedin` \| `pinterest` \| `threads` \| `snapchat` | no | One platform, or leave empty for the whole map |

### `social.compare`

Compare up to five brands on one platform: share of voice and efficiency.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | `youtube` \| `instagram` \| `reddit` \| `x` \| `tiktok` \| `facebook` \| `linkedin` \| `pinterest` \| `threads` \| `snapchat` | yes | Which platform to compare on |
| `handles` | array | yes | Two to five handles, the client's first |
| `limit` | integer | no | Posts to read per account |

Build a bank of hooks from what measurably worked, not from imagination.

Work out where one brand is actually strongest, across platforms.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `limit` | integer | no | Posts to read per platform |

Put a finished post in the client's approval queue.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

## workflow

### `workflow.check_memory`

Read what the team has already learned about this site: problems
solved, decisions taken, and what would reverse them.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signature` | string | no | A specific problem signature to look up |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many entries |

### `workflow.create_experiment`

Set up an SEO split test: a change applied to some pages and withheld
from comparable ones, measured against a named metric.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Short name for the test |
| `hypothesis` | string | yes | What you expect to happen and why |
| `change_description` | string | yes | Exactly what changes on the variant pages |
| `variant_urls` | array | yes | Pages receiving the change |
| `control_urls` | array | yes | Comparable pages left unchanged |
| `metric` | `clicks` \| `impressions` \| `position` \| `ctr` \| `conversions` | no | What to measure |
| `duration_days` | integer | no | How long to run |

### `workflow.log_resolution`

Record how a blocker was resolved, so nobody re-solves it.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `internal` · **Runs unattended from:** `observe`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `problem` | string | yes | What was blocking, specifically |
| `decision` | string | yes | What was decided or done instead |
| `rationale` | string | no | Why this was the right call |
| `reverses_if` | string | no | What evidence would change this decision |
| `attempts` | array | no | What was tried before this, in order |
| `rung_reached` | integer | no | Which rung of the ladder resolved it |
| `human_required` | boolean | no | Does this still need a person |
| `human_atom` | string | no | The single action a person must take, if any |
| `scope` | `site` \| `org` \| `platform` | no | How widely this applies |

### `workflow.read_experiment`

Read an experiment's result: variant versus control, the lift, and
whether the difference is large enough to act on.

**Mutates:** no · **Risk:** `none`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `experiment_id` | string | yes | The experiment |

### `workflow.schedule_mission`

Schedule a recurring mission for this site. Use this during onboarding
to set the cadence, and to adjust it when a site's needs change.

**Mutates:** yes · **Risk:** `low` · **Runs unattended from:** `assisted`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mission_key` | string | yes | Which mission to run |
| `cron` | string | yes | Standard 5-field cron, in UTC |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | Turn it on |
| `input` | object | no | Fixed arguments for every run |
